sources.title: S3Gen Model Architecture | resemble-ai/chatterbox | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: The S3Gen model architecture implements a two-stage speech synthesis pipeline that converts S3 speech tokens into high-quality audio waveforms. This system is the core synthesis engine for both text-to-speech and voice conversion in ChatterboxTTS, operating at a 24kHz sample rate with support for streaming inference.
